metadata.settings_status: Prepared, loaded and validated offline; no upload or hardware start.
metadata.comparison_group: 100 s feedforward / P / PI at nominal 35 +/- 5 C

calibration.qualification: Measured static curve; Module 4 settling audit remains applicable. Revalidate with the rod attached.

metadata.ratio_source: Same Module 4 measured heating/cooling ratio as the existing P200 and PI100 records.
metadata.ambient_method: Record current measured room temperature before this new physical run; no previous-day ambient is substituted.
metadata.control_equation: u_raw = Kp*(T_set-T_TEC); negative commands multiplied by ratio, then clamped to +/-pwm_limit. Ki=0 and integral is inactive.
metadata.gains_source: Kp=50 PWM/C, Ki=0; match the existing P200 proportional gain and PI100 Kp for the P/PI comparison.
metadata.anti_windup_note: Enabled in the plan for consistency; P-only control has no integral term to wind up.
metadata.Ua_Ub_note: Ua_pwm and Ub_pwm are zero inactive placeholders in temperature modes. Do not reuse the feedforward raw-PWM Ua/Ub in this P plan.
metadata.duration_note: 300 s = three full 100 s cycles, per operator instruction to ignore settling as a repeat trigger. Keep startup in the raw file; elapsed time alone does not certify a settled comparison.
metadata.expected_startup: Kp=50 can reach the existing PWM cap during a cold start. Record saturation including startup; it is not silently excluded or claimed absent.
metadata.safety_note: Existing firmware TEC 10-45 C operating guard, 60 C backup limit and 56 C rod-base guard are unchanged.
